questions.question: After Joshua and the elders of his time died, what was different about the next generation of Israelites?

answers.text: They did not know the LORD or His works
They did not know the land of their inheritance
They did not know which tribe they came from

questions.question: When Israel turned away from God, the LORD raised up judges. What did these judges do for Israel?

answers.text: Wrote down new laws for Israel

questions.question: In the time of the judges, what happened to Israel whenever a judge died?

answers.text: They became even more corrupt than their fathers
They turned back to the LORD for good
They asked for a king to rule them

questions.question: Why did the LORD leave some nations in the land instead of driving them all out before Israel?

answers.text: To test whether Israel would walk in His way
To pay tribute to Israel every year
To guard the borders of the land
